policy: Second-tier reference quotes from EGamersWorld's match pages for fixtures that remained unresolved after session arena-57b1ee04's initial capture. Only pages that publish an explicit bookmaker-average quote in the betting-tips block are accepted. Pages that print only the default 1.8 / 1.8 banner with no bookmaker-average quote are recorded under rejected and cannot supply a pick. First-party market (Polymarket, Kalshi) and bookmaker (Thunderpick, Bovada) lines always take priority over this rung.
